about.title: Hundreds of injury claims since he opened his own office in 1985
text: Wes Klinger, Jr. graduated from South Texas College of Law in May 1981 and worked for a Houston personal injury firm until 1985. In those years he handled personal injury cases both in the United States and internationally.

One of them was a maritime personal injury case that went to the U.S. Supreme Court, and our client won. In 1985 he started the Wes Klinger Law Office, and since then we have handled hundreds of injury claims and wrongful death cases for Texas victims.

We try to settle with the insurance company first, and we will file suit if those talks reach an impasse. No case is too big or too small for us to review, at no cost to you, and if we can't take it, we will help you find someone who can.
